scenarios.name: Dismiss the remaining title strip of a hidden expanded panel

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon at the top
the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned
the user opens the panel selector and clears Modify
the Modify main panel and additional commands are hidden
a small Modify title strip remains beneath the ribbon
the panel selector remains open with Modify unchecked
the user clicks the remaining Modify title strip
the title strip and panel selector close
the user opens the panel selector and selects Modify
the additional command area remains closed
the panel selector remains open with Modify checked
the user clicks the panel selector control
the selector closes and the Modify main panel remains visible
